Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years, every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: A detailed cancer-related history and physical examination should be conducted regularly to monitor for signs of recurrence.
Annual mammography is recommended for the intact contralateral breast to monitor for new primary breast cancer.
Postmenopausal breast cancer survivors should have periodic DEXA scans to monitor bone density, especially if they are on aromatase inhibitors or have osteoporosis.
Postmenopausal women on selective estrogen receptor modulator therapies should receive an annual gynecologic assessment to monitor for endometrial cancer.
